text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My name is Satono Diamond, and I'll<n>be your guide
today. It's nice to meet<n>you all.

text_block_list.name: French Observers
text_block_list.text:
It is truly an honor to have a current<n>runner and
trainer show us the<n>campus!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond's father requested<n>that we show
the academy grounds<n>to a group of observers for a
potential<n>student exchange program. They<n>appear to
be trainers from France.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Shall we begin with the training track?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Here we are—the training track. We<n>use a
reservation system for<n>afternoon training.

text_block_list.name: French Observers
text_block_list.text: So this is where all the students train?<n>Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it surprising? I haven't seen<n>them myself, but
rumor has it that the<n>training centers in France are
quite<n>expansive.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
This is the observation team from<n>France, yes? I'll
help show them<n>around.
choice_data_list: Who told you there was an observation team?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Does it really matter?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You're interested in going abroad,<n>right? By all
means, please join us!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Swimming is also a part of our<n>mandatory training
curriculum. The<n>pool is fifty meters long...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Our student living facilities consist of<n>the Ritto and
Miho dormitories.<n>Cleaning services and meals are
provided by the academy.

text_block_list.name: French Observers
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for giving us such an<n>informative tour
today. It will be a<n>great reference for next time
we're in<n>Japan.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The observation team drives off and<n>disappears
into the distance. I breathe<n>a sigh of relief... but
Satono Diamond<n>looks grim.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking about what they<n>told me about
France.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It really felt like their training scene is<n>completely
different than in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
There isn't much in the written<n>material pertaining
to what we'd truly<n>like to know either.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It's like a track. You can read about it,<n>but you can't
really know what it's<n>like until you've run on it
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I agree. I think that means the<n>Umamusume in
France might not be<n>familiar with the scene in
Japan<n>either.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Would you both mind coming with<n>me for a spell?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond brings us to Tokyo<n>Racecourse.
We've been granted<n>access to certain parts of the
premises, under supervision of a<n>member of the
URA.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: So what are we doing here on a day<n>with no races?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We're shooting a video. The footage<n>will be used
for a VR Umalator.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I intend to develop VR Umalation<n>software that
can be used to simulate<n>running on tracks around
the world!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The idea came to me today when I<n>was speaking
with the inspection<n>team. I'm sure there are many
who<n>can't race at their best abroad<n>because they
aren't used to the<n>environment.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to get rid of those<n>disadvantages. I want to
create a tool<n>that will help racers adjust to the
various environments abroad!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha! You're as gutsy as ever! I<n>imagine you're
aiming to recreate<n>everything in this Umalator, from
training right down to the races<n>themselves.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I plan to get permission<n>to film the
course on behalf of the<n>Satono company.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'd also like to film at courses in other<n>countries as
well. Starting with<n>France!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
More international tours are sure to<n>make the
racing world even more<n>exciting. I wish to do
everything in my<n>power as an Umamusume of the
Satono family to make that happen!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, you're so passionate. That's<n>not a bad
thing, though. The more<n>people run abroad, the
more thrilling<n>races there will be, I'm sure.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'll dance. Lead on, Miss<n>Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! I'm sure there<n>are some
things that only current<n>runners such as ourselves
will pick<n>up on. Please share all of your<n>thoughts!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond's mission to<n>galvanize the racing
world as a<n>competing member of the Satono<n>family
has begun!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hi, Sirius! Thanks to your help, we've<n>started
development on the simulation<n>software in earnest!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Then, when it's all done,<n>you're gonna
dance with me on the<n>world stage until dawn
breaks. Right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, all right. I hope everyone can<n>put it to good
use!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Also, the French observers asked me<n>to pass on
their thanks. Do you<n>remember how we showed
them<n>those good luck charms when they<n>were
looking for souvenirs?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you mean the ones from that<n>shrine near
campus?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's right. It seems their trainees<n>have seen a lot
of benefits from<n>them! Apparently, they're singing
their praises!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Maybe more Umamusume will<n>come to
Japan to get one of their<n>own.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'd love for more Umamusume to<n>come and run
here, no matter the<n>reason!
